but that same thing is done here?
static constexpr bool LG2_COMMIT_DBUS = @lg2_commit_dbus@;
Acknowledged

@spinler@us.ibm.com

I checked how these values are populated and found that they are not
fixed constants—they are derived from Yocto configuration.

For example, `error_info_cap` is computed via
`get_info_cap(d)` based on FLASH_SIZE and can also be
overridden (e.g., via `ERR_INFO_CAP` and EXTRA_OEMESON).

So the final value (128 in my build) is platform-dependent,
not constant. Similar applies to other values like
`redundant-bmc` and `lg2_commit_strategy`.

Given this, hardcoding them would remove intended
configurability.
Acknowledged

The TODO was referencing specifically what you changed:
 
@TODO(stwcx): These values are currently configured in autoconf but never
              modified by anyone, nor could I see why they ever would be.

That meant that these constants aren't doing '@' substitutions so don't need to be in config.h.
Acknowledged
Thanks for creating the new file.  just a few minor things.
We can just get this info from the commit message, so comment not necessary.
Acknowledged
Instead of including this so everyone gets it, can you just add this include to the users that need those constants?
Acknowledged
can also just get this from the commit message if someone is curious.
Acknowledged
I think the config/ dir is probably only meant for the config.h stuff that is intertwined with the meson options, so how about moving this up a dir?  (Unless you have a strong reason to keep it here)

@spinler@us.ibm.com moved the constants.hpp under lib/include/phosphor-logging to keep it consistent with the existing public header layout of the library.do Lemme know if you would prefer a different location
it isn't a public header, so you can just move it direclty phosphor-logging/
